_meta.what: Twelve synthetic Mission Control task records for interface design. Each 'task' object is shaped exactly like a row returned by GET /api/tasks (the Convex tasks table).
rules: Every name, client, company, person, email, URL, path, and prompt is neutral placeholder text with the same character length and line structure as the live record it mirrors.

Enum values (status, assignee, priority, growthLane, doneEvidenceType, approvalState, workstream, dueDateSource) are real schema literals. 'jt' is the operator and 'eve' is the operator's AI agent; both are schema values, not placeholders.
Timestamps are fixtureNow plus the live record's offset from capture time. Ids and hashes are synthetic.

A field is present only when the mirrored live record has it, so field presence per card is real. The set as a whole is weighted toward hard cases; the true population distribution is in 01-data-contract.md.
'observedLive': false marks a fixture built from backend rules because no live record exists (expired card, feedback history).

fixtures.mirrors: Q-family decision card (Q1 shape); same 9 fields every one of the 31 decision cards carries
fixtures.notes: All 31 live decision cards have no evidenceLinks, whyItMatters, exactSteps, or pasteReadyPrompt field. Their structure lives in description prose: a First action line, 4-5 bold-label bullets, then identical Why it matters / Done / Guard lines on all 31. 19 of 31 (all Q and AP) end with an empty '- **Answer:**' bullet that JT is expected to fill; the backend has no typed answer field. Bold labels match the live structure labels (Why, Answer, Change, Evidence, Recommendation, Draft, Status, Choose, Built differently) except 'Question', 'Proposed answer', and 'Reviewer note', which stand in for labels that were not extracted.
